title: The racks the back room uses
summary: Storage in Supermarket Simulator is racked rather than piled: the game keeps data for a rack, a further record for the boxes racked on it, and a third for the boxes that stand on their own.
body: A rack is a thing in data. The game keeps rack data of its own, which is why a rack can be placed and understood by the shop rather than being a piece of scenery with boxes stacked against it.

Boxes on a rack are recorded separately. There is a record for a racked box of its own, so what is on a rack is known as a relationship between a box and the rack it sits on rather than as a loose object.
Boxes that stand on the floor are recorded too. There is a record for a box on a stand of its own, which is why a box in the back room and a box on a rack are two different things to the game.
Storage as a whole has data. There is storage data of its own, which is where the back room's arrangement is kept rather than being read back off the objects each time.
A rack is defined before it is recorded. There is a definition of a rack of its own, which is why one rack and another can share a shape rather than each being written out separately.
Being racked is a state. A box on a rack is an object of its own and a rack has a state of its own, which is why putting a box away is a change the shop tracks rather than only a movement.
The image beside this entry is the game's own: the artwork it ships for a tall rack of the kind the back room uses, a steel upright with five levels.
What this entry does not tell you: how many racks a back room takes, how much a rack holds, or what either costs. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: A rack has data of its own.
A box on a rack is recorded on its own.
A box on a stand is recorded separately from one on a rack.
Storage has data of its own.
A rack is defined by a definition object of its own as well as recorded.
A box on a rack is an object of its own and being racked is a state.
The game ships its own artwork for a tall rack of the kind the back room uses.
The racks are named in sizes of their own, a small one beside the tall one.
